questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. They will deliver the package tomorrow.

options.text: The package was delivered by them tomorrow.
options.html: The package was delivered by them tomorrow.

questions.solution:
The correct option is a: The package will be delivered by them tomorrow.

Rule of changing Active voice into Passive voice:

Subject + shall/will + V1 + object ---- Object + shall/will + be + V3 + by + subject

Explanation:

In the active voice, "They will deliver the package tomorrow," the subject "they" is performing the action. In the passive voice, the focus shifts to the object "the package," and the correct transformation is "will be delivered." The time expression "tomorrow" remains unchanged.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech. Hemant said, "I will meet you at the station."

questions.solution:
The correct option is B: Hemant said that he would meet me at the station.

To convert the sentence "Hemant said, 'I will meet you at the station.'" into indirect speech, follow these steps:

Change the pronouns: "I" becomes "he" (because Hemant is talking about himself), and "you" becomes "me" (because Hemant is speaking to someone else).

Adjust the verb tense: "will meet" changes to "would meet" in indirect speech.

Include "that": Introduce the indirect speech with "that" (optional in informal speech).

So, the correct option is:

Hemant said that he would meet me at the station.
